description: Acquire finite raw correlation histograms for the requested TimeTagger channel pairs without deriving physical estimates.
summary: Acquire correlation histograms for selected Time Tagger channel pairs.

deviceId.description: TimeTagger device that acquires the requested correlation histograms.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact lease union: only the TimeTagger when latchGuard is disabled, or that TimeTagger plus every network-resolved detector-health guard when it is required.

items.description: One device needed by this finite acquisition.

correlations.description: Unique correlation-histogram definitions acquired together in one finite window.

correlationId.description: Caller-stable identifier used as the output-map key.

durationSec.description: Finite integration duration of the shared correlation window, in seconds.

clear.description: Whether every selected correlation histogram is cleared before the window.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window detector-latch policy; disabled permits an unguarded observation, while required validates network-declared detector-health guards and retries only the invalid window.

mode.description: Whether detector-latch validation is disabled or required for this observation.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries after a recovered detector latch; use zero to reject the first invalid window.

acquisition.correlation.observation.wind.description: Verified context and raw device response for the completed shared correlation window.

acquisition.correlation.plan.definitions.description: Resolved stable histogram definitions indexed by correlation identifier.

acquisition.correlation.observation.hist.description: Raw delay and coincidence histogram arrays indexed by correlation identifier.

acquisition.correlation.status.latchGuar.description: Explicit latch-guard policy, health samples, accepted-window attempt, discarded-window count, and any terminal guard failure.
